messages:
elaine: Heads up — product asked for a single console view that shows per-org quota, per-key usage, and current burst credits. They want green/yellow/red status and the ability to drill into which keys are consuming bursts. Can we map this to current enforcement model?

sam: We currently enforce at org-level first, then per-key as a fallback for burst throttles. The console only shows org-level remaining quota today.

priya: For visibility we could expose a summarized per-key leaderboard (top 10) with token counts and a toggle to show burst credits used. But we need to be careful with PII — only key ids + usage, no user emails.

matt: Query/telemetry point: our metering table stores (org_id, key_id, window_bucket, tokens). We can build the leaderboard off that but it will add read load to the metrics DB during spikes. Suggest pre-aggregating into a moving-hour rollup.

elaine: UX ask: product wants plan mapping overlayed — free/pro/enterprise tiers and what burst envelope each gets (e.g., free: 60s cooldown, pro: 5s bucket). Is that deterministic or config-driven per org?

sam: The enforcement knobs are config-driven. Default mapping is: free -> softcap + limited burst, pro -> higher softcap + managed burst, enterprise -> reserved capacity (no soft throttle). We store plan on org record.

priya: For the console we should show an explainer tooltip with exact numeric values (tokens/min, burst tokens, cooldown). Would also surface recommended upgrade CTA when an org repeatedly hits softcaps.

matt: Implementation note: exposing burst credits means we need to persist current credit balance somewhere fast — Redis is fine but must be eventual-consistent for display. Don't rely on counters that are only in the token-bucket in memory on a host.

ops-bot: deploy:quota-metrics-service v2 promoted to staging @ 2026-03-18T09:22Z

sam: Rollout plan: ship console read-only first (no controls), run for 2 weeks to validate telemetry and DB load, then add admin controls to adjust per-org burst window. Canary to 5 enterprise orgs.

elaine: Agreed. Priya — can you mock the UI copy for the tooltip and the upgrade message? Matt — can you estimate extra read QPS and Redis cost for storing live burst balances? I'll coordinate product legal on what key-level info is safe to show.

priya: Will do — mock by EOD. Suggest the tooltip copy be short: "Burst credits allow short spikes above your plan quota. Shown balance is approximate and may lag by a few seconds."

matt: I'll prototype the rollup query and add a Redis shard estimate tomorrow. Preliminary guess: +15% read QPS on metrics DB during high-traffic dashboards.

elaine: Great. Filing follow-ups: 1) mock UI (Priya) 2) telemetry load estimate + costs (Matt) 3) endpoint to return top-keys (Sam) 4) legal privacy check (Elaine). Back here for status by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
